name: io.github.GlideWorth/glideworth
title: Glideworth
description: Glideworth is a personal financial planning engine (retirement / life-plan projections).

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer workspace API key (gwk_...) or OAuth access token (gwa_...). With neither, the server returns 401 and WWW-Authenticate points at /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/mcp (OAuth 2.1, PKCE S256). Browser session cookies are not accepted.
